Evaluation recursively follows listed dependency order, reusing valid memo entries.","holds":"function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let d=input.config.deps,v=input.config.values,m={};function inv(x){delete m[x];for(let k in d)if(d[k].indexOf(x)>=0)inv(k)}function ev(x){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,x))return m[x];let q=d[x],z;if(q.length===0)z=v[x];else{z=0;for(let i=0;i<q.length;i++)z+=ev(q[i])}m[x]=z;return z}for(let i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){let e=input.events[i],o=output[i],c=0;if(e.type==='set'){if(d[e.node].length===0){v[e.node]=e.value;inv(e.node)}if(o.value!==null||o.computed!==0)return false}else{let before=Object.keys(m).length,z=ev(e.node),a=Object.keys(m).sort();if(o.value!==z||o.computed!==Object.keys(m).length-before||JSON.stringify(o.valid)!==JSON.stringify(a))return false}}return true}","mapping":"config.deps and config.values map node IDs to dependency lists and leaf values; state stores current leaf values and memoized node values; event.type selects evaluation or invalidation.","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){const d=config.deps;let s=state;if(s===null){s={v:{},m:{}};for(const k in config.values)s.v[k]=config.values[k]}function drop(x){delete s.m[x];for(const k in d)if(d[k].indexOf(x)>=0)drop(k)}let computed=0,value=null;if(event.type==='set'){if(d[event.node].length===0){s.v[event.node]=event.value;drop(event.node)}}else{function get(x){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.m,x))return s.m[x];let q=d[x],z;if(q.length===0)z=s.v[x];else{z=0;for(let i=0;i<q.length;i++)z+=get(q[i])}s.m[x]=z;computed++;return z}value=get(event.node)}return{state:s,output:{value,computed,valid:Object.keys(s.m).sort()}}}"}
